units.source_text: 在悠闲的莺声中，鸟装女童开始舞蹈。

en.t: Amid the leisurely song of the warblers, the little girls dressed as birds began to dance.

units.source_text: 伴奏舞蹈的乐师奏出《迦陵频伽》之曲，

en.t: The musicians accompanying the dance played the melody of Kalavinka,

units.source_text: 音调非常优美，湖中的水鸟也被感动，在不知什么地方鸣啭起来。

en.t: and its tones were so beautiful that even the waterfowl on the lake were moved and began calling from somewhere unseen.

units.source_text: 舞乐将终，曲调转急，情趣越发优美，可惜舞乐告终了。

en.t: As the dance music neared its end, the tune grew quicker and its charm became still more exquisite, but alas, the performance came to an end.

units.source_text: 蝶装女童的舞蹈比飞鸟更为轻快，渐渐舞近棣棠篱边，飞进了繁密的花阴中。

en.t: The dance of the little girls dressed as butterflies was lighter even than flying birds; little by little they danced toward the kerria hedge and flew into the dense shade of the blossoms.

units.source_text: 皇后的次官以及身份相当的殿上人，都向皇后领取赐品来犒赏女童。

en.t: The Empress's deputy officials and courtiers of comparable rank all received gifts from her to reward the little girls.

units.source_text: 赐鸟装女童的是白面深红里子的常礼服每人一件，

en.t: The girls dressed as birds were each given one formal everyday robe with a white outer face and deep crimson lining,

units.source_text: 赐蝶装女童的是棣棠色衬袍每人一件。

en.t: and the girls dressed as butterflies were each given one under-robe in the color of kerria blossoms.

units.source_text: 赐品都是按照情况而预先准备好的。

en.t: All the gifts had been prepared in advance according to the occasion.

units.source_text: 赐乐师的是每人白色衣衫一袭，或绸缎一卷，各有等差。

en.t: The musicians were given either a set of white garments each or a roll of silk, with distinctions according to rank.

units.source_text: 赐夕雾中将的是女装一袭，外加淡紫面绿里的常礼服一件。

en.t: Lieutenant General Yugiri was given a set of women's robes, together with one formal everyday robe of pale purple outside and green lining.

units.source_text: 秋好皇后复紫夫人的信中有云：“昨日船游之乐，令人艳羡欲泣。

en.t: In the letter that Empress Akikonomu sent back to Lady Murasaki, she wrote, "The pleasure of yesterday's boating excursion made me so envious I could have wept.
